scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten full-frame tiles have readable captions. Gold direct amodal rectangles appear only on positives.

The owned target is a dark diagonal tapered silhouette inside each positive rectangle, tail/flukes lower-left and nose upper-right. Its presentation becomes a small narrow mark with little anatomical detail at 3–4 cm/px.

All negatives lack the corresponding central dark form and rectangle and look essentially uniform blue at contact-sheet scale; no overlapping or unrelated background animal is discernible in these tiles. All were retained and reviewed.
No material row-to-row background shading/detail difference is discernible at this scale. This does not establish bitwise/photometric equivalence.
